corrected_scope: The prior one-coordinate subcritical packing inequality is valid. Its multi-coordinate product use is valid for fixed anchors and for acyclic/triangular anchor dependence. It is false to infer dimension-free summability from coordinatewise theta_i<1 alone when anchors depend cyclically on other fragment labels.
counterexample: For N equal intervals I_k=[2(k-1)/N,(2k-1)/N], midpoint anchors a_1(l)=c_l and a_2(k)=c_k yield an exact cyclic sum S_N. If Theta=theta_1+theta_2>1 then S_N>=N^(Theta-1); if Theta=1 then S_N grows at least logarithmically.
impact: Localization proofs with fragmented active coordinates must use an acyclic elimination order or supply extra aggregation/cancellation across cycles. The select-before-localize partner theorem is unaffected because its active smoothing coordinates are not fragmented.
